summary: Cipher Digital Inc. (formerly Cipher Mining; NASDAQ: CIFR) priced $850.0M of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2032 in a Rule 144A private offering to qualified institutional buyers, with a 13-day option for up to $150.0M more; settlement is scheduled for October 16, 2026. Concurrently, Cipher expects to exchange roughly $165.9M principal of its 1.75% convertible notes due 2030 for about 40.7M shares in privately negotiated transactions. The filing names no advisor, board recommendation, or use-of-proceeds detail. Watch for dilution from the share exchange, note overhang, hedge/convert arbitrage flows, and final settlement mechanics.
